title: Distinguish signs from reported information

variants.label: 降りそう · appearance

segments.role: The verb stem 降り takes そう. The speaker judges an imminent event from signs.

variants.change: The verb stem 降り takes そう. The speaker judges an imminent event from signs.

variants.label: 降るそう · hearsay

segments.role: The plain verb 降る takes hearsay そう. The source of the information changes even though the sentences look similar.

example.note: Information from a forecast or another source.

variants.change: The plain verb 降る takes hearsay そう. The source of the information changes even though the sentences look similar.

question: A forecast tells you rain is expected. Which form reports that information?
feedback: Plain clause + そう reports heard or read information. Stem + そう describes appearance or imminent signs.
